overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: two Board members' remarks at three School Committee meetings were not deliberation among a quorum of the Board, so the complaints were closed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged Board deliberated on public business through oral communication at the December 20, 2011 School Committee meeting.
allegations.key_passage: minutes that the two Board members communicated with each other during the meeting regarding the pay phone issue, thus there was no deliberation for purposes of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged Board deliberated on public business through oral communication at the January 10, 2012 School Committee meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Selectman McLatchy did not participate in the discussion that followed, and was present only to take meeting minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged Board deliberated on public business through oral communication at the April 10, 2012 School Committee meeting.
allegations.key_passage: He did not participate in any discussions with Chair Abbott.
